spoken_summary: Representative Barbara Lee delivers a speech addressing "radical extremists." She warns that if they criminalize people for having abortions or take away the right to make personal decisions about one's body, they will be challenged at the polls. She states, "We will see you at the ballot box in November," and concludes with the rallying cry, "When we fight, we win."

central_claim: Voters will oppose anti-abortion politicians, described as 'radical extremists', at the ballot box in November for their attempts to criminalize abortion.
intended_effect: To galvanize and motivate pro-choice voters to participate in the upcoming November election.
